name: Tamar (Absalom's daughter)
title: Absalom's beautiful daughter
summary: Tamar was Absalom's daughter, named after his sister. The Bible tells us she was a beautiful woman. She is the only one of Absalom's children mentioned by name, since his sons died.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Absalom's daughter
keyEvents.description: Absalom had three sons and a daughter named Tamar, who was a beautiful woman.
